d.f: Confirmed terminal ordering defect: a Gen4 route-reassert captured under close-cycle 10/generation 80 can execute after controller terminal NATIVE_COVER generation 83 and is accepted, returning daemon authority to PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT with owner 80. The terminal return is serialized behind that reassert on coverMutationExecutor and only restores IDLE later.
d.why: ensureCoverRouteHeld validates controller state before launching but captures the old cycle/generation and has no pre-result terminal/current-generation fence. DuoShellService serializes Gen4 commands on coverMutationExecutor. reassertCoverPanelGen4 checks only expected owner and then powers/re-activates without first refusing when coverLeaseTopology().nativeCover is already true. Thus a pre-terminal queued mutation can outlive terminal handoff.
d.risk: This exactly violates terminal native-cover ownership and creates a multi-second post-terminal PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT window. It is a strong causal mechanism for the observed black/unresponsive-cover class, though physical black-screen causality still requires Fold7 confirmation.
d.next: Primary should add a daemon-side native-cover terminal fence to prepare/reassert (check before mutation and again after physical wake/before route activation), returning an authoritative IDLE/NATIVE_COVER snapshot instead of re-owning the old cycle. Add deterministic queue-ordering regression test and 30-70 degree physical endurance gate. Preserve close thresholds/visual path.
d.test: Minimal state replay of queued old reassert -> native-cover terminal -> queued return reproduces COVER_PREPARING(owner=80, held=true, routeReady=false) without fence; guard leaves NATIVE_COVER with no owner/hold.

en: CONFIRMED: Gen4 can execute an old generation-80 cover reassert after the controller has already completed NATIVE_COVER generation 83. Because cover mutations are serialized, the later terminal return cannot preempt it. The daemon reassert path lacks a native-cover terminal fence, so it re-enters PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT for several seconds. Add a daemon-side native-cover fence to prepare/reassert and regression-test this exact queue ordering; do not change the now-smooth close thresholds.
